name: Froot Basket White
source:
You wake to a bright white light. A stranger named Azrael greets you and solicits your help to save your friend, Momotarou. They need you to collect information about the demon holding Momotarou captive. 

However, this info is spread across space and time, and Azrael must send you to different realities to find it.

[From [url=https://xxmissarichanxx.itch.io/froot-basket-white]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在明亮的白光中醒来。一个名叫阿兹瑞尔的陌生人向你打招呼，并请求你帮助拯救你的朋友桃太郎。他们需要你收集有关俘虏桃太郎的恶魔的信息。

然而，这些信息遍布时空，阿兹瑞尔必须将你送往不同的现实才能找到它。

[来自[url=https://xxmissarichanxx.itch.io/froot-basket-white]Itch.io[/url]]
